newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia to issue $500,000 bonds on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia to issue $500,000 bonds on Friday.

text.p: Mongolia will issue 300 million tugriks ($500,000) worth of discounted bonds on Friday, the Ministry of Finance said on Wednesday.
This is the first time Mongolia is issuing such discounted bonds, the ministry said. The issue will be open to foreign investors, it added.
The 90-day-bonds will be issued at 9,100 tugriks and on maturity will reach 10,000 tugriks, it said. The bonds will be traded through brokers in Mongolia.
Profits from the discounted bonds will be tax-free, the ministry said.
The government has announced it would issue short-, medium- and long-term bonds worth 15 billion tugriks in the currency fiscal year.
